docs.title: Probability Laboratory
docs.text: Probability Laboratory (plab) is a Python project for exploring Probability Theory, Statistics, and Machine Learning.

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Implement mathematical algorithms in Python.
  • Explain the underlying mathematical theory.
  • Test correctness and numerical behavior.
  • Compare implementations with established libraries.
  • Provide reproducible educational examples.

docs.title: Current Status
docs.text:
Version 0.1.0 — Project foundations.

Mathematical implementations are not yet available.
